body:
Codex pre-review (not a collaborator review; no marker) @ 5d47d22d1916076c45b645c20ac9c0d875a14b43

Verdict CLEAN

No findings. Read #1709 and the full diff. Local merge with upstream/main was already up to date.

- All three named pins passed: filled_pocket_names_the_model, narrow_pocket_names_the_tool, stock_allowance_names_the_clearance_needed.
- cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main: GREEN.
- cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings: GREEN.
- Mutation: disabled the new too_narrow message condition. Both new diagnostic pins went RED; the filled-model pin stayed green. Restored the condition; all three pins went GREEN. Working tree is clean.
- Extra safety case: a blind pocket cut below its closed floor could gouge. The gate ran both blind_floor tests, including the analytic motion checks across entries and stepdowns; both passed.
- Rules: changed files are 371, 98 and 22 lines. No added production unwrap/expect/panic. No golden, PNG, PROCESS_VERSION, dependency, .github or scripts changes. Changelog: and Fixes #1709 are present.

The STEP sample and release gate were not exercised.

Fixed the requested sample-test finding.

- Updated the expected refusal and doc comment. `the_sample_as_imported_refuses_the_3d_pocket_by_name` pins the exact tool-clearance text from the imported STEP sample.
- Added `camcraft_motion::machining3d` to the gate map. The quick gate selected and passed `shared_face_bodies` (5 passed, 1 heavy test ignored).
- Mutation check: disabling the ladder narrow-area flag made the sample pin fail. Restoring it made the pin pass. The old expectation also failed before the update.

Quick gate against upstream/main and clippy for app and motion with all targets and warnings denied are green. The PR body now records the sample coverage.

New head: aa10962369d1b21d6d13e3bf765f4da64c824a88.
Please re-review.

<!-- pr-reviewer: aa10962369d1b21d6d13e3bf765f4da64c824a88 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

Review tier: standard. This change selects the empty-pocket error text. It does not change posted G-code, motion, geometry, stock simulation, or gouge and collision checks. No goldens changed. No UI files changed, so screenshots are not required.

The full diff and issue #1709 were checked. The new flag records a nonempty target that becomes empty after tool-clearance erosion. The error keeps the same `GenError::Empty` variant. Callers use that variant, so their control flow stays the same. Both pocket entry points have tests for the model, tool diameter, and stock allowance cases.

The previous requested changes are complete:
- The imported STEP sample test expects the new tool-clearance text and passes.
- Its test comment explains the correct cause.
- Its gate map includes `camcraft_motion::machining3d`. The quick gate selects the suite.
- The PR body records the sample test result.

All checks ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-1739`, after a clean trial merge with main `c785c14bd1c726d0042b7c5b98f0a13d5b7b5a5d`. No GitHub runner was used.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base c785c14bd1c726d0042b7c5b98f0a13d5b7b5a5d` | PASS: 392 passed, 0 failed, 7 ignored |
| Motion unit tests | 343 passed, 5 ignored |
| Motion suites: blind_floor, engagement_3d, entry_arc, entry_arc_3d, level_links, one_descent, pocket3d_hsm, pocket_refusal, refusal_ghost | 44 passed, 1 ignored |
| App suite: shared_face_bodies | 5 passed, 1 ignored |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | PASS |

Mutations: none in this review. The change affects error text only, so the safety-tier mutation requirement does not apply. Source code was not changed. The release gate and ignored heavy tests were not run.

Requested before merge: none.

The decision record, provenance, commit subjects, and PR closing lines meet the project rules. No dependency, build script, workflow, snapshot PNG, or process file changed.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
